description: Election Commission - S. V. S. Perera was Selected as a member of the Horana Pradeshiya Sabha
reasoning: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy for a member of the Horana Pradeshiya Sabha (a local authority) due to a resignation, as per the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. The content involves the electoral process for a local government body, specifically the nomination and declaration of a new member, which falls under the Elections category (Type 7).
